scene_mara_00_intro.text: Mara stands beside a brass telescope, hair glowing in starlight. "You’re just in time," she says, adjusting the lens. "The sky is performing for us tonight."

mara_A.text: You move close, shoulders brushing. Mara inhales softly. "Intense." Her smile curves. "I like intense."

mara_B.text: She guides your hands on the telescope controls, fingers sliding over yours. "Like this," she murmurs. "Feel it?"

mara_C.text: You compliment her passion for astronomy. She beams. "People forget I care about things beyond red carpets."

mara_fail.text: Mara gives you a graceful nod, smile dimming. "Maybe next time."

mara_success_1.text: She steps closer, voice dropping. "Come with me. I want to show you something the others never notice."

mara_success_2.text: Her eyes lock on yours. "You're distracting," she whispers. "In a good way."

mara_success_tame.text: She links her arm with yours. "Walk with me? I could use a break from talking about myself."
